title: Our party of 6 ranged...
text: Our party of 6 ranged from 50 -80 years old.  Danial was extremely good with us and made sure everyone stayed together and had the best time. Thank you so much!!
author: k_w

title: Great bike tour on a cold day
text: Our bike tour with Seebybike was really great. We chose a cold day in December so we wore extra layers. Our guide Ivan was very knowledgeable/ informative with a good sense of humor. We had taken the bus tour the day before but that was disappointing. You really get to see so much more on a bicycle. I'd highly recommend this tour. Gavin from Dublin
author: 107gavinw

title: Pleasant discovery of Seville by bike with Laura
text:
Great time shared for our group of 9! Our francophone guide Laura walked us, told us, pampered us for 3 hours 
It was a really nice experience to cycle through the streets! Thanks to her and her team!
author: GrandTour45661468034

title: Biking Sevilla's streets at the sunset
text: The tour with Iván was one of the most entertaining. He created a pleasant and fun atmosphere and group dynamic with his friendliness. I would recommend the experience to others!
author: 616lr

title: Seeby bike with Daniel is brilliant!!!
text: We had a brilliant time on our bike tour with Daniel. he was very entertaining and informative. He was very thoughtful and careful in guiding us around this beautiful city. He has a good line in the history peppered with light jokes. This is by far the best way to see this beautiful city because you can cover a lot of ground easily while appreciating the wonderful architecture and historical ambiance. It ended too soon! Fairly easy cycling. Brilliant guide! Highly recommended by all 4 of us!! Thank you Daniel!
author: kentscott1

title: Great Bike Tour
text: Pauiel was very knowledgeable, we really enjoyed the tour and it was great to see so much of the city. He gave us lots of recommendations too with genuine advice of where to go for authentic Spanish cuisine. We would highly recommend.

title: A must do Seville experience
text: A fabulous morning on the bike, we visited all the top tourist sights of Seville. Manu was a wonderful guide who gave us snippets of Seville/Spain’s history. I would highly recommend for anyone who visits the city.
